plan.text:
# Delegate webhook timeout

> **Status: approved.** One step. A step PR implements the plan and does not
> edit this document.

## Why

Slack retries a delivery that takes longer than three seconds, and the webhook
handler has been landing just under the Lambda's 30 second timeout when it has
to resolve the GitHub App installation and start an ECS task on a cold cluster.
The retry starts a second agent run against the same PR, which is the
duplicate-review case the per-sha S3 lock does not cover because the two tasks
land at slightly different times.

## Step 1

Raise the `delegate-webhook` Lambda's timeout in
`deploy/components/webhooks.ts` from 30 seconds to 60 seconds.

Nothing else changes: the memory size, the runtime, the role, the environment
variables and the function URL stay as they are, and the ECS task definition is
not part of this step.

## Out of scope

- The agent deadline (`AGENT_DEADLINE_MS` in `delegate/worker/entrypoint.ts`).
- The webhook's Slack signature check.
- Any change under `deploy/components/worker.ts`.
